meta.title: AutoCircuit automation playbook
meta.purpose: Everything a new conversation or agent needs to drive Cadence Virtuoso/Spectre on UCSD ieng6 for this repo without rediscovering it: how to reach the server, how to run jobs, how results come back, and the traps already hit.
meta.repo: https://github.com/TimmyXu015/AutoCircuit (public -- never commit keys, IBM PDK model contents, or homework answers)

user_and_policies.who: UCSD student, ECE 203 (Fall 2026). Writes in Chinese; reply in Chinese. Self-described weak software and device-physics fundamentals: explain, do not just dump.
user_and_policies.homework_rule: The user does the homework reasoning. Build tooling, run simulations, return data + plots, point to where/how to read a quantity; do NOT hand over final homework answers unless the user explicitly delegates that part (e.g. they delegated tedious PDK-file grepping for P1e/P1g Vt).

results_folder.path: C:\Users\Timmy\AutoCircuit_Results\  (connected folder on the user's Windows PC; device_bash sees it as $HOME/mnt/AutoCircuit_Results)

layout.LOG.md: index table: date | [title](<exp>/log.md) | figure names. Add one row per new experiment (escape '|' in titles as \|).
layout.<YYYY-MM-DD>_<job>_<short_desc>/: ONLY log.md + PNG figures. Nothing else.
layout.<exp>/log.md: short Chinese record: '# title', a line '`<exp>` · 原始数据与脚本：`_raw/<exp>/`', then bullets 电路 / 仿真 / 运行 (run.sh job, CIW call) / 图 (each PNG with a few words) / 记录 (facts seen in the data, or how to read a quantity). For homework items: setup + how to read, not the answer unless the user delegated it.
layout._raw/<exp>/: CSVs, MATLAB plot scripts, text reports, model copies, netlists. Plot scripts read data from their own folder (here = fileparts(mfilename('fullpath'))) and export PNGs to the experiment folder: [~,e]=fileparts(here); out=fullfile(fileparts(fileparts(here)),e).

results_folder.rule: The user wants a tidy lab notebook, not chat dumps: every experiment ends with log.md + PNGs + a LOG.md row. NEVER delete anything there -- the user deletes (they may delete _raw entirely). Moving within the folder is fine.

user_and_policies.server_processes: The user often has their own GUI Virtuoso running on the same ieng6 host (it holds .cdslck locks and spectre sessions). Never kill the user's processes without asking.
user_and_policies.style: Deliver results, not narration. Final reply: what came out, the file, one next step.

access_paths.summary: The cloud container (Bash tool) cannot reach ieng6. The device_bash Linux VM on the user's PC has proxy-only network (no ssh). The working path is the MATLAB MCP server on the user's Windows PC: mcp__remote-devices__MATLAB__evaluate_matlab_code running system('ssh ...') with Windows OpenSSH.

ssh.user_host: lix015@ieng6-ece-10.ucsd.edu  (ieng6-ece-20.ucsd.edu also in known_hosts; plain ieng6.ucsd.edu FAILS with 'Host key verification failed' under BatchMode)
ssh.key: C:\Users\Timmy\.ssh\id_ed25519 (passwordless). Public key line in ieng6 ~/.ssh/authorized_keys, comment autocircuit-DESKTOP-IECEG8R -- removing that line revokes access.
quoting_rules: system() goes through cmd.exe: the remote command sits inside one pair of double quotes; inside it use NO further double quotes and avoid pipes combined with escaped quotes (\" breaks, '%' gets expanded).
Use pgrep -a -f, head, tail instead of 'ps | grep "..."'.

Anything non-trivial: write a script file into the results folder (device_bash heredoc), scp it up, then ssh 'bash script.sh'. Strip CR (char(13)) from files written on Windows before running them on Linux.
ssh.environment: Non-interactive ssh has no module environment: wrap Cadence commands in bash -lc '...' (single quotes doubled inside a MATLAB string: ''...''). run.sh also loads the course module itself if MODULESHOME is set.
ssh.long_jobs: Bridge calls time out at ~60 s and the device connection drops now and then. Start jobs detached and poll: ssh host "cd <workdir> && nohup bash -lc '~/AutoCircuit/run.sh <job>' > ~/AutoCircuit_results/<job>_run.out 2>&1 < /dev/null & echo started"; then tail that file in later calls. Never put pause() + ssh in one call longer than ~45 s.
ssh.file_transfer: scp one remote file per call: scp -o BatchMode=yes -q lix015@ieng6-ece-10.ucsd.edu:<remote_path> "C:\...\folder". Several remote paths in one quoted argument failed ('No such file').
ssh.after_disconnect: If the device disconnects mid-call, the remote job may still have run: check its output file before re-running anything.

access_paths.viewing_results: To look at a PNG yourself: mcp__remote-devices__device_stage_files (path under a connected folder) -> Read the staged path -> SendUserFile it to the user.
access_paths.matlab_tips: exportgraphics(gcf, '<abs path>.png', 'Resolution', 130). Plot scripts start with 'clear', so compute paths inside the script (mfilename) or use literal absolute paths after run(). readtable(..., 'VariableNamingRule','preserve') keeps CSV headers. Several figures: findall(0,'Type','figure') and export each by its Name.

server.cadence_workdir: /home/linux/ieng6/ECE203_FA26_001/lix015  (holds cds.lib; start Virtuoso / run.sh from here)
server.course_module: module use /home/linux/ieng6/ECE203_FA26_001/public/modulefiles; module load ECE203_FA26_001  (interactive shortcut: type ECE203_FA26_001)
server.sim_dirs: ~/simulation/<cell>/spectre/schematic/...  (ADE L's own folder; OCEAN helpers use a suffix, e.g. schematic_family, so they never overwrite ADE L results)
server.pdk_models: /acsnfs3/software/IBM7RF/IBM_PDK/cmrf7sf/V2.0.0.2AM/Spectre/models  (design.scs, wafer.scs, allModels.scs section=tt). Files are IBM CONFIDENTIAL: copy only to the user's PC, never into this repo.
server.project_lib: Project -- the user's library for the ECE203 ECG project (DEFINE in the workdir cds.lib, created 2026-11-15 in Library Manager, attached to cmrf7sf). Put every ece203_* cell here.

standard_loop: 1. Edit/add SKILL in this repo (cloud container), commit, push. If remote says the repo moved, set origin to https://github.com/TimmyXu015/AutoCircuit.git.
2. Start the job detached on ieng6 via MATLAB system('ssh ... nohup bash -lc ''~/AutoCircuit/run.sh <job>'' ...') from the cadence workdir.
5. Put the plot script (keep a copy in matlab/ of this repo) next to the data in _raw, run it; it exports PNGs into C:\Users\Timmy\AutoCircuit_Results\<date>_<job>_<desc>\.
6. Write <exp>/log.md and add a row to LOG.md (see user_and_policies.results_folder.layout).
7. Stage + Read the PNG to check it, then SendUserFile. In chat keep it short: what came out, how to read it; leave homework conclusions to the user.

what_it_does: git pull first (so new jobs are found), then loads the course module if virtuoso is missing
non-GUI job: virtuoso -nograph with the batch file on stdin

GUI job (batch file contains '@gui', needed for ADE L): xvfb-run -a -s '-screen 0 1600x1200x24' virtuoso -replay <file>; a watcher kills Virtuoso ~10 s after a CDS-log output line matching '^.o AC_BATCH_'
sets AC_BATCH=1 (acFinish then dbClose's cellviews instead of opening windows -> no stale locks)
prints status (AC_BATCH_DONE / AC_BATCH_FAILED), all 'AC>' lines, *Error* lines, and the M0 line of the fresh netlist
run_sh.batch_file_pattern:
;; comment
load(strcat(or(getShellEnvVar("AC_ROOT") strcat(getShellEnvVar("HOME") "/AutoCircuit")) "/ac.il"))
acBatch('fnName)
exit()        ; omit exit() in @gui jobs

skill_framework.entry: ac.il: acRoot from $AC_ROOT or ~/AutoCircuit; acFiles load order (pdk -> libs -> circuits); acJobs maps job symbol -> list of zero-arg step functions; acGo("job") in the CIW = pull + reload + run + report to ~/AutoCircuit_results/ciw_<job>.txt; acReload(); acBatch(fn) for run.sh.
add_a_job: write <name>.il with a zero-arg entry function and add it to acFiles in ac.il
add batch/<job>.il (pattern above); '@gui' in a comment if it needs ADE L / a display

libraries.pdk_cmrf7sf.il: acPdk: device lib cmrf7sf, model path, modelFiles ((design.scs "") (wafer.scs "") (allModels.scs "tt")), PDK desVars p5vonly/phires = 0, subNet sub!
libraries.lib_draw.il: acPinPt, acPlace (place instance so a named pin lands on a point), acWire (with label; filters freed wires), acGnd, acStub, acSetParam (runs CDF callback), acSetFirstParam, acSubTie (0 V source sub!->gnd), acOpenSch, acFinish (schCheck + markers report, save, close in batch), acDumpParams
libraries.lib_sim.il: acSimSetup(lib cell corner dirSuffix), acNum, acLog10, acResultsDir, acWavePoints (waveform -> list of (x y)), acZinAc
libraries.lib_ade.il: acAdeStart, acAdeModels, acAdeVars, acAdeAnalysis(sess type fields choices), acAdeChoice, acAdeOutput, acAdeSaveCurrents, acAdeSave, acAdeProbe (dumps the asi API of this install), acAutoOkStart (timer that answers modal dialogs)
libraries.acSay: printf + log file; uses lsprintf (never apply('sprintf ...))
libraries.ece203_lib.il: ECE203 helpers: ece203Place/ece203Elem (grid placement, every pin a labelled stub -> connections by net name, ground = label gnd!), ece203FetSpec, ece203Pins/ece203Symbol (pins + auto symbol via schViewToView, regenerated when the pin set changes), ece203Finish (abort on schCheck errors), ece203Setup (acSimSetup + delete old analyses), ece203OpDump/ece203MinMargin (dcOpInfo table), ece203SaveNetlist.

skill_framework.hw1_helpers: hw1_setup.il: hw1Nmos/hw1Pmos configs, hw1Build, hw1Ade, hw1Check, hw1P1cFamily(?pmos t ?vdsList ... ?vAt 0.25 ?plots t) -- one ordinary DC run per VDS, curves copied to memory, CSV + plotted family in the GUI

ade_l_api_verified.vars: asiSetDesignVarList(sess list(list("vgs" "0") ...))  (include PDK vars p5vonly, phires)
ade_l_api_verified.analysis: ana = asiGetAnalysis(sess 'dc); set choice fields FIRST (sweep "Design Variable", rangeType start/stop, incrType linear, stepTypeLin step) via asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices + asiSetAnalysisFieldVal; then fields designVar AND param (netlister reads 'param, otherwise spectre: 'Missing sweep parameter'), start, stop, step, saveOppoint; asiEnableAnalysis(ana) LAST (takes the analysis object).
ade_l_api_verified.ac_analysis: fields start stop dec; choices sweep freq, rangeType start, incrType log, stepTypeLog decade
ade_l_api_verified.license_dialog: envSetVal("license" "ADEXL_UseNextLicense" 'string "always") before opening ADE, otherwise a modal 'Next License' dialog freezes headless runs; acAutoOkStart() as backup.
ade_l_api_verified.tran_analysis: field 'stop works. 'maxstep and 'step are in the field list but asiSetAnalysisFieldVal does not take them (ADE-5704 / reads back nil). Setting 'errpreset "conservative" froze a headless GUI job until the 600 s timeout -- do not set it.
ade_l_api_verified.outputs_op: sevAddExpression accepts OP("/M0" "gm") style expressions and bandwidth(VF("/vout") 3 "low"), VAR("fin") (added without error; evaluated by the user in ADE).
ade_l_api_verified.noise_analysis: asiGetAnalysis(sess 'noise): choice fields sweep Frequency, rangeType Start-Stop, incrType Logarithmic, stepTypeLog 'Points Per Decade', outType ('voltage' | 'probe', default probe!), inType ('voltage' | 'current' | 'port' | 'none', default port); text fields start stop dec, p '/vout', n '/gnd!', inVsrc '/VIN' (input voltage source; iprobe is NOT the field ADE uses for a voltage input). Outputs: getData("out" ?result "noise"), getData("in" ?result "noise") in V/sqrt(Hz). OCEAN: analysis('noise ?start ?stop ?dec ?p "/vout" ?n "/gnd!" ?iprobe "/VIN") works.
ade_l_api_verified.create_library: ddCreateLib(name dir) creates the library AND adds DEFINE to the cds.lib of the working dir; attach technology with techSetTechLibName(ddGetObj(name) "cmrf7sf") (check with techGetTechLibName). Back up cds.lib first.
ade_l_api_verified.probe_fields: To learn an analysis' field names: asiGetAnalysisParamNameList(ana) + asiGetAnalysisFieldChoices(ana f) for each (hw3ProbeAnalysis). Some listed names (readns, force, save, oppoint ...) raise ADE-5704 when read -- harmless.
ade_l_api_verified.vcvs: analogLib vcvs: terminals PLUS MINUS (output) NC+ NC- (control), gain CDF param 'egain' (accepts a design variable); netlists as 'E1 (out- ... ) vcvs gain=aol' with vout = egain*(V(NC+)-V(NC-)).
ade_l_api_verified.ocean_current_save: OCEAN: save('i "/VIN/PLUS") then i("/VIN/PLUS" ?result "ac") works (current into the source's + pin, so Zin = v/(-i)).
ade_l_api_verified.stb: OCEAN: analysis('stb ?start "1m" ?stop "100M" ?dec "10" ?probe "/IPRB") with an analogLib iprobe (pins PLUS/MINUS) in series in the loop; getData("loopGain" ?result "stb"). Spectre's loopGain phase is +180 deg for plain negative feedback, so PM = phase(loopGain) at |loopGain| = 1. The calculator phaseMargin() assumes 0 deg and returned PM - 180. Do not reference the phase at the lowest frequency either: with a capacitive high-pass feedback network the low-f loop phase is not 180 deg.
ade_l_api_verified.opinfo_hierarchical: dcOpInfo name of a device inside a subcircuit instance is '/XA/M1' (pv("/XA/M1" "gm" ?result "dcOpInfo")). Names 'XA.M1.rgate', 'XA.M1.ddb', 'XA.M1.cwgs' ... are the cmrf7sf parasitic sub-elements.
ade_l_api_verified.symbol_from_schematic: schViewToView(lib cell lib cell "schematic" "symbol" "schSchemToPinList" "schPinListToSymbol") works in -nograph batch. Pins: schCreatePin(cv dbOpenCellViewByType("basic" "iopin"|"ipin"|"opin" "symbol") name dir nil xy "R0"); a wire label of the same name connects reliably.
ade_l_api_verified.subckt_params: Spectre subcircuits see top-level design variables: a cell whose instances use c=cc works with desVar("cc" ...) in the testbench (all instances share the value).
ade_l_api_verified.xmin: OCEAN xmin(w) returns the x at the MINIMUM y, not the first x. First x: drGetElem(drGetWaveformXVec(w) 0).
ade_l_api_verified.analysis_reset: Analyses persist across acSimSetup calls in one Virtuoso session; delete('analysis 'dc 'ac 'noise 'stb 'tran) before switching testbench (a leftover noise analysis can name a source the next tb does not have).
ade_l_api_verified.noise_summary: OCEAN noiseSummary works in -nograph batch: port = outfile(f "w"); noiseSummary('integrated ?result 'noise ?from 0.1 ?to 250.0 ?output port) or noiseSummary('spot ?result 'noise ?frequency 1.0 ?output port); close(port). Text table: 'Device Param Noise Contribution % Of Total' rows (output-referred V^2, or V^2/Hz for spot), then 'Total Summarized Noise = x' and 'Total Input Referred Noise = y'. Params: fn flicker, id channel thermal, rn resistor; device names /XA/M1, /XFB/RP; XA.M1.rgate etc. = cmrf7sf parasitic resistors. Rows sum to the total (checked 0.999997). Parse with gets/parseString/atof (ece203_noise_scan.il nsSummary).
ade_l_api_verified.integ: OCEAN integ(w a b) on a PSD^2 waveform gives the integral in linear Hz (trapezoid): rms = sqrt(integ(nin*nin 0.1 250)). 20 points/decade agreed with 50 points/decade to 0.1 %.
ade_l_api_verified.design_var_width: cmrf7sf pfetx/nfetx accept design-variable W/L (w = "w12in"); set ad/as = "w12in*0.54e-6" and pd/ps = "2*(w12in+0.54e-6)" as expressions. One netlist then serves a whole sweep (desVar per point, no schematic rewrites).
ade_l_api_verified.stb_analysis: asiGetAnalysis(sess 'stb): same sweep choice fields as ac (sweep Frequency, rangeType Start-Stop, incrType Logarithmic, stepTypeLog Points Per Decade), text fields start stop dec, and 'probe "/IPRB" (reads back). Other fields: localgnd, usingProbeMode, stbProbeMode (default "differential"). Verified 2026-11-16 (ece203_ss_ade).
ade_l_api_verified.noise_inVsrc_only: Noise with inType voltage: setting only 'inVsrc "/VINP" (no 'iprobe) reads back fine.
ade_l_api_verified.sim_options: asiSetSimOptionVal(sess 'gmin "1e-18") (also 'iabstol, 'reltol) works and reads back with asiGetSimOptionVal; saved into the ADE state (ece203_ss_pr_ade, 2026-11-16).
ade_l_api_verified.analoglib_switch: analogLib switch: pins N+ N- (switched) NC+ NC- (control), CDF vt1 (open voltage) vt2 (closed voltage) ro rc; netlists as Spectre relay vt1 vt2 ropen rclosed. analogLib vpulse CDF: v1 v2 td tr tf pw per dc acm. No analogLib 'relay' cell.
ade_l_api_verified.ocean_pss_pnoise: OCEAN: analysis('pss ?fund "1M" ?harms "50" ?errpreset "moderate"), analysis('pac ?sweeptype "relative" ?relharmnum "0" ?start ?stop ?dec ?maxsideband "3"), analysis('pnoise ?sweeptype "relative" ?relharmnum "0" ?start ?stop ?dec ?maxsideband "49" ?p "/o" ?n "/gnd!") work; results() -> (pss_td pss_fd pac pnoise ...); harmonic(v("/o" ?result "pac") 0) = baseband transfer; getData("out" ?result "pnoise") = output PSD (V/rtHz). ?noisetype did not appear in the netlist (Spectre default used).
ade_l_api_verified.vsource_noisefile: Custom noise PSD on a source: analogLib vdc CDF 'noisefile' = absolute path of a text file 'freq V^2/Hz' per line -> netlists as noisefile="..." and shows in NoiseSummary as ext_file_noise. The F1..F50/N1..N50 + FNpairs fields did NOT reach the netlist in batch.
ade_l_api_verified.ocean_mismatch_mc: OCEAN monteCarlo keys here: numIters startIter seed analysisVariation sweptParam sweptParamVals saveData saveProcessParams nomRun samplingMethod numBins append (no ?nominalRun). monteCarlo(?numIters "12" ?startIter "1" ?analysisVariation 'mismatch ?saveData t ?seed "12345") + monteRun() runs (PDK process.scs has statistics{ mismatch{} }). monteOutputFile does not exist and iterVsValue returned nil; read the results instead with openResults(<psf dir>) selectResult('ac) -> waves with sweep ("iteration" "freq"); value(mag(w) f) / cross() give iteration-indexed waves (ece203_r4_c4read).

pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.devices: nfet/pfet (3-terminal, bulk on global sub!), nfetx/pfetx (4-terminal with B). CDF params w, l, nf (strings like "5u"). Netlists as inline subckt nfet/pfet -> BSIM3v3 (version 3.24) model nch/pch.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.substrate: Global net sub! must be tied (acSubTie: 0 V vdc sub!->gnd), and never label a net that is also gnd! (schCheck errors).
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.cdf_callbacks: PDK callbacks (e.g. bicmos7wlfetWidthp) fail outside a form (concat error) -> ad/as/pd/ps may be stale; acSetParam sets cdfgData/cdfgForm and logs failures. Simulation results were still correct for W/L checks.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.pmos_bench: p1_pmos: source+bulk to gnd, drain at -vsd, gate at -vsg (orient MX) so sweep variable vsg and currents stay positive.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.model_file_structure: allModels.scs section X includes fixed_corner.scs section=X, process.scs, process_psp.scs, models.scs. Parameters like vth0 are expressions in process.scs: base constant + statistical term + fixed-corner adder (fixcnr*skewfix(...)) + wafer-specific term (k_wafer). In section tt fixcnr=0 and every adder evaluates to 0 (cor_*=0, k_wafer=0, mismatch mvth0=0), so the tt value is the base constant. Grep the model dir for <param>_n / <param>_p to find them.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.diffusion_params: CDF callbacks fail outside a form, so ad/as/pd/ps stay at the 0.43u-default values (ad=2.322e-13) whatever W is -> drain junction caps far too small for wide devices. Set them yourself: ad = as = W*0.54u, pd = ps = 2*(W+0.54u) (sps.il spsDiffParams; works with a design variable too: ad=wn*0.54e-6).
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.op_readout: pv("M0" <param> ?result "dcOpInfo") works for the nfet subckt (gm, gds, id, vth, vdsat, region, cgg, cgs, cgd, cdd, cdb, cjd ...). region: 2 = saturation, 3 = subthreshold. Other dcOpInfo names under M0 are the PDK's parasitics: M0.cwgs/cwgd/cwds (wiring caps), M0.ddb/dsb (junction diodes), M0.rgate/rsext/rdext. Integers (region) need float() before %g formatting.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.cell_list: Device cells are in /acsnfs3/software/IBM7RF/IBM_PDK/cmrf7sf/V2.0.0.2AM/cdslib/cmrf7sf (nfet, nfetx, pfet, pfetx, *_rf, 25/33/50 V variants, resistors such as opppcres/oprppres/rppres families, mim/dualmim caps). pfetx (4-terminal) was already used and simulated in HW1 P1g, so the 'pmos not verified' note in pdk_cmrf7sf.il is stale for pfetx.
pdk_notes_cmrf7sf.symbol_pins: nfetx pins (R0, relative to origin): G (0,0); D (0.25,0.1875); B (0.25,-0.0625); S (0.25,-0.1875). pfetx: G (0,0); S (0.25,0.1875); B (0.25,0.0625); D (0.25,-0.1875). S, B, D share x = 0.25 and the instance bBox includes text, so stubs drawn 'away from the bBox centre' crossed (S-B short). ece203Stub uses the box of the pin positions instead. analogLib vdc/idc/res/cap: PLUS (0,0), MINUS (0,-0.375). vcvs: PLUS (0,0), MINUS (0,-0.375), NC+ (-0.125,-0.125), NC- (-0.125,-0.25). iprobe: PLUS (-0.0625,-0.3125), MINUS (0.0625,-0.3125).

gotchas: sprintf via apply() re-evaluates args -> use lsprintf.
%g rejects integers in SKILL format strings -> pass floats (5.0 not 5).
't' is reserved in SKILL; do not use it as a variable.
Text replacements in ac.il once landed inside acLoadAll's header -> edit by exact blocks and re-read the file.
GUI schematic editing auto-merges wires and frees wire objects -> filter with dbValidP before labelling.
Xvfb must be 24-bit ('-screen 0 1600x1200x24'); 8-bit breaks Virtuoso.
exit() inside a -replay file fires mid-job -> no exit() in @gui jobs; the run.sh watcher stops Virtuoso.
The watcher must match output lines ('^.o AC_BATCH_'), not the echoed source that contains the same text.
Killed batch Virtuoso leaves .cdslck lock files -> GUI opens the cell read-only. Batch now dbClose's; stale locks can be removed only when no Virtuoso owns them (ask before killing a user process).

OCEAN paramRun: the top-level result index referenced a log file only run 1 had, so the family read back as one curve -> loop ordinary run()s and copy each waveform to memory (acWavePoints) right after its run.
OCEAN results dir: use a suffix dir (acSimSetup ... "_family") so ADE L's own results are not overwritten.
cmd.exe on the PC: '%' and nested \" break commands (see access_paths.ssh.quoting_rules).
Over ssh, '*Error* eval: unbound variable - f' sometimes appears in run logs before the job; it has been harmless (status still OK).
Bridge: 60 s per call; device may disconnect -> detach long work with nohup and poll.

Starting a detached job (nohup ... &) over ssh from MATLAB system() sometimes still blocks the bridge until the job ends (> 60 s timeout). The job runs anyway: never re-launch after a timeout, check <job>_run.out first. 'ssh -n' + setsid + disown helped once but not always.
While a MATLAB system() call is still running, further evaluate_matlab_code calls return empty output (not an error) -- wait and retry.
Transferring a script to the PC: base64 it and write with fwrite(fid, matlab.net.base64decode('...')) in one evaluate call -- no quote escaping.

f_t via cross(db20(IF(/VDS/PLUS)/IF(/VGS/PLUS)) 0 1 "falling") needs the drain source to be AC-quiet (acm = 0). With VDS at mag=1 the h21 'plateau' sat above 0 dB for 2u/0.18u and cross returned nothing. ft_extrap = |h21(1 Hz)| x 1 Hz is kept as a cross-check.
run.sh prints only the first 40 report lines; the full log is ~/AutoCircuit_results/<job>.log.

Ad-hoc Virtuoso over ssh: 'bash -lc virtuoso' does NOT find virtuoso -- source $MODULESHOME/init/bash, module use .../ECE203_FA26_001/public/modulefiles, module load ECE203_FA26_001 in a small script first (or use run.sh).
PDK CDF callbacks bicmos7wlfetWidthp/Length/Width fail in batch (concat error); set ad/as/pd/ps explicitly (W*0.54u, 2*(W+0.54u)) via cfg->nParams.

Re-saving an ADE L state that already exists opens a modal 'sevblockingDialogBox' Warning (overwrite?) that hangs GUI batch jobs (the auto-OK timer stops ticking too). acAdeSave now deletes the old state (ddGetObj(lib cell stateName) -> ddDeleteObj) before asiSaveState. If a GUI job shows no progress for minutes, look for 'Displaying modal dbox' in ~/AutoCircuit_results/<job>.log.cds and kill only that job's own processes.

analogLib vdc netlists 'mag=1' (AC magnitude 1) when acm is left at its default in this installation, so every supply/bias/VSUB source also drove AC analyses (HW1 P2 gain, HW2 f_t h21, sps/spsg AC results before 2026-10-28 are affected). acDcOnly(inst) sets acm = 0; every builder now calls it on DC-only sources. Always grep the netlist for 'mag=' after building an AC bench.

ipcSleep() inside a GUI job blocks the event loop, so an ADE run started with sevNetlistAndRun never completes (spectre is killed when run.sh stops Virtuoso). Verify ADE setups by the netlist it writes (~/simulation/<cell>/spectre/schematic/netlist/input.scs), simulate with OCEAN.
SKILL rexMatchp has no '|' alternation; use several index()/rexMatchp calls.
Python edits that cut 'from marker to end of file' can silently drop later procedures -- check that every acJobs function still exists (grep 'procedure( name') before pushing.

HW2 f_t results before 2026-10-28 were taken with VDS/VSUB at mag=1; corrected (5u/1u ft at vgs 0.25: 37.4 MHz cross, matches gm/(2pi Cgg) 37.0 MHz; the 'h21 levels off above 0 dB' finding for 2u/0.18u was an artifact of that, not device physics).
OCEAN resultsDir(<dir>_suffix) moves psf only: the netlist of an OCEAN run is still written to ~/simulation/<cell>/spectre/schematic/netlist/input.scs (the cell's default folder).

An ATTACHED tech library leaves no tech.db in the library folder (that is only for 'compile a new techfile'). Check attachment with techGetTechLibName(ddGetObj(lib)) or 'strings <lib>/data.dm | grep -A1 techLibName'. The 'group foundry of techDB cmrf7sf conflicts with ASCII file' warnings appear in every batch log (hw2setup, hw3build, ece203_hp) and are harmless.

Launching a job from MATLAB: system('ssh ... nohup ... &') often blocks until the job ends (bridge timeout at 80 s, and MATLAB returns empty output for later calls until it ends). Use system(['start "" /B ssh -n ... "cd ... && setsid nohup bash -lc ''...'' < /dev/null > /dev/null 2>&1 &"']) -- returns in 0.1 s. Chain several jobs and a final tar in ONE nohup bash -lc '...; ...'.

ieng6 refused ssh (Connection closed, then port 22 timeout for ~1 min) after ~20 ssh/scp connections in a couple of minutes. Fetch results as one archive: tar czf on the server, one scp, then extract on the PC with device_bash 'tar xzf X --overwrite -C <dir>' (plain tar xzf fails with 'File exists' because deleting is not allowed in the notebook folder).

device_bash (Linux VM on the user's PC) reaches raw.githubusercontent.com: put plot scripts in the notebook with curl -sSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/TimmyXu015/AutoCircuit/<commit-sha>/matlab/<file>.m (use the sha, the main-branch URL is cached).
Results files from the notebook reach the cloud container with device_stage_files (paths under C:\Users\Timmy\AutoCircuit_Results), e.g. to copy summaries into docs/ece203_data/.
Pushing from the cloud container needs the repo attached to the session with push access (add_repo access=push); before that the git proxy returns 403.

Spectre dcOpInfo 'region' = 3 (subthreshold) says nothing about Vds: in Round 2A M1/M2 had |Vds| = 76 mV (A0 down 4x) and still reported region 3. Check |Vds| - max(|Vdsat|, ~0.1 V) and A0, not only region.
OCEAN noiseSummary/getData read the LAST run: rerun the point before asking for its summary (nsAll reruns the baseline before the spot summaries).

ieng6 DISK QUOTA is 5 GB per user across ALL course dirs on /home/linux/ieng6 (quota -v). On 2026-11-15 it was full (old ECE260B_WI26 dir 4.0 GB + home 1.1 GB): OCEAN then fails with 'Disk quota exceeded' / 'Could not create directory' while run.sh still says status OK. Check quota before long jobs. Each OCEAN resultsDir suffix creates its own psf folder (1-14 MB, tran more): delete this round's ~/simulation/<cell> folders after the data is exported (user-approved for ECE203 load runs). Never delete design sources; ask the user.

run.sh prints 'status: OK' when the SKILL job finished even if individual OCEAN runs failed (no ac result, quota). Always check the produced CSV rows / 'no ac result' lines in the log (log may need grep -a: it can contain binary bytes).

Shell variables ($j, $1, awk $2) do not survive MATLAB system() -> cmd -> ssh -> bash -lc '...' quoting: a for-loop over job names ran nothing. Write the job names out explicitly; avoid $ in remote one-liners (use find -printf, du, cut instead of awk).

SKILL has one global namespace for procedures: a second procedure( ldA3(...) ) silently replaced an earlier helper of the same name (error appeared only as 'too many arguments'). Keep helper names unique across all ece203_*.il files.
CSV fields written from SKILL that may contain commas (free-text 'variant') must be quoted; ece203_load.il ldWriteRow now quotes them.
stb phase at the UGF can come back wrapped (-212 deg = +148 deg): otaStb now adds 360 when negative. In a multi-loop chain probe one loop at a time (other probes are 0 V and keep their loops closed).
scp -r of a whole results folder is one connection (use it instead of many scp calls); device_stage_files accepts at most 50 files per call.

Spectre noiseSummary 'Total Input Referred Noise' is referred to the ?iprobe source (single-ended). For a differential-input amp, refer the output PSD by |H_dm| point by point (run noise on the same f grid as ac and divide) -- ece203_ss does both; they agree when |G_P| ~ |H_dm|.

stb on a closed loop whose in-band |T| < 1 (e.g. 5T A0~71 with beta~1/101): cross(db20(lg) 0 1 "falling") finds the low-frequency crossing made by the large feedback resistor (~0.1 Hz) -- report 'no in-band UGF', not that PM.
dcOpInfo 'region' comes back as an integer (e.g. 3): acNum(x "%g") / sprintf %g on it aborts the whole job -> float() it first (hit in ece203_ss_lscan).

TOhm pseudo-resistors / fA currents: Spectre default gmin 1e-12 S and iabstol 1e-12 A swamp the device (measured r 0.03-0.3 TOhm instead of 4-10 TOhm, S2 fL 18.9 Hz instead of 0.057 Hz). Use OCEAN option('gmin "1e-18" 'iabstol "1e-18" 'reltol "1e-6") after acSimSetup (check simulatorOptions line in the netlist) and verify KCL (I_A == I_B == device id).

SKILL: inside a procedure, a local variable named v does not break calls to the OCEAN function v(...) (separate function slot), but name variant/config locals something else (e.g. var) to keep reviews unambiguous.

PMOS-input 5T in a TB built for NMOS-tail OTAs: the bias current must be SUNK from IBIAS (idc PLUS ib MINUS gnd) because the reference is a PMOS diode to VDD; check the netlist instance pin order (GND IBIAS INN INP OUT VDD).

Ideal chopper with relay switches: two-phase clocks MUST be non-overlapping. With edges crossing at the same instant both phases are half-on: the OTA inputs see (p+n)/2 (VCVS output slams to 0) and p/n are shorted through low-R transitional switches, bleeding the signal charge every edge (step response decayed to ~0). 10 ns dead time fixed it (ECE203 Round 3D).
run.sh called through a plain 'ssh host cmd' (no login shell) fails with 'virtuoso not found'; wrap it as bash -lc '~/AutoCircuit/run.sh job' like the nohup launches.
The user also pushes to main (task docs). Always git pull --rebase before pushing; a rejected push means run.sh on the server will NOT see the new job -- relaunch after the push succeeds.

Spectre: vsource pacmag must be >= 0 (use pacphase 180 for a negative drive). analogLib vpulse instances placed by SKILL inherited a previous instance's pacm (-0.5) when pacm was not set -> set pacm explicitly on every vpulse.

MATLAB system() + ssh: a remote command whose file variable expands empty (e.g. grep pattern $f with no file) makes grep read stdin forever and blocks the MATLAB session (all later calls return empty). Always use 'ssh -n' and '< /dev/null' for inspection commands; recovery needed the user to press Ctrl+C in MATLAB.
SKILL append() takes exactly two lists -- nest append(append(a b) c) for three.

Single-stage cap-feedback OTA (Zout_cl ~ tens of MOhm) cannot drive a passive 250 Hz output LP of 3.18 MOhm/200 pF: fH collapsed to 20 Hz (Round 4 A). Check output loading before adding passive filters.

OCEAN analysis('pnoise ... ?noisetype "timeaverage") is accepted but the netlister writes no noisetype (pnoisemethod=default only) -> the run uses the Spectre default; verify in the run's netlist, do not claim timeaverage from the OCEAN call (Round 5 D).

OCEAN runs with ece203Setup(cell suffix): netlist is ~/simulation/<cell>/spectre/schematic/netlist/input.scs (shared, overwritten by the next run of that cell); results go to schematic_<suffix>/psf. Copy the netlist right after run(); ece203SaveNetlist's 'find | head -1' can pick another run's file.
r4Row/r4Open/r5Open need the column list as SYMBOLS ('(tag cell ...)); a list of strings fails in symbolToString before any simulation.

Ideal 4 kHz chopper (1 ns edges) + real OTA: PNoise maxsideband 30 -> 50 raised the de-embedded noise 11.8 -> 14.3 uV (+21%): folded OTA white noise is not converged; compare positions only at equal maxsideband.

Single-ended ideal demod (EINV around a fixed reference) turns the OTA's unchopped output level into a square wave: 0.36-0.39 V pp at fb, 33 mV pp after a 1st-order 250 Hz LP (Round 5 D). Demod placed before a source follower drove the follower to cutoff every half period and raised its 1/f 28x.
Python edits of .il files with s[:a]+new truncate everything after index a - Round 5 lost the stage E code this way; always splice s[:a]+new+s[b:] and re-check the procedure list before pushing.

Open-loop CM plant identification of a high-gain FD OTA: a VCVS DC servo (gain 1e4) on the load gate made DC fail ('Matrix is singular at ia'); working recipe = keep the real CMFB for DC through 1 TOhm and inject the AC actuator through a 1e6 F capacitor (loop open for f >= 1 mHz) (Round 6A).
Ideal static controllers whose input includes a DC-offset error (e.g. CMFB systematic -21 mV) can wreck the DC solve; AC-couple such terms (1e6 F / 1e12 Ohm) so the DC point is the plant's.

Two-pair (differential-difference) NMOS CMFB in subthreshold: exact for symmetric DM, but with a chopped 1 mV offset (Vod ~185 mV steps) the output CM sagged ~34 mV -> linear range is the limit for FD chopper outputs.
MOS-switch (TG) tran with the tight R4 tolerances (iabstol 1e-18, reltol 1e-6) failed at 3 us (convergence below minstep); unit bench ran with defaults + gmin 1e-15 (Round 6B).
OCEAN xmax(w) is the x of the maximum y, not the end time; last sample = drGetElem(x drVectorLength(x)-1) with x = drGetWaveformXVec(w) (drVectorGet does not exist).

Disk quota: a 10 ms TG tran at 50 ns maxstep with save=allpub left ~80 MB of psf per run and filled the 5 GB quota mid-job (close: Disk quota exceeded). Use saveOption('save "selected") + save('v ...) for long switch trans and delete the run dirs after export.

PSS of the R6A FD system with real MOS TG choppers (2 kHz, 100 uV offset, TOhm Rfb): shooting norm oscillated (1e6..4) and with tstab 10 ms the time step collapsed to ~0.4 as at a clock edge; ideal relays had converged in R6A. Needs a different PSS setup (e.g. smaller edges/longer tr, method/gear, or harmonic balance) or a long-tran steady-state check.
Pseudo-R corner scales ~linearly with width (prw 3/3.5/4/4.5 um -> fL 0.077/0.089/0.101/0.112 Hz, L 2 um); verify w=prw in the run netlist (Round 5N).

Real-bias benches (r4SpecsRB): VDDD is a 0 V ammeter from vddd to vdd, so I(VDD) already includes the DRL current I(VDDD); total power = I(VDD) x 1.8 V (do not add I(VDDD) again). In the R4 ideal-bias/R6A benches VDDD is a separate 1.8 V source.

cmrf7sf pfetx flicker vs L at fixed current (R5N-L, W 8u, 616 nA, L 16->36 um): gm ~ L^-0.49, input-referred mirror 1/f only ~ L^-0.62 (device gate-referred 1/f ~ L^-0.13, not the 1/sqrt(WL) area law).

MATLAB MCP evaluate_matlab_code times out at ~80 s on the device side; never pause() > ~60 s in one call (a timed-out call keeps MATLAB busy and the next calls also time out). Sleep in the cloud container's Bash instead, then poll with a short call.

In MATLAB system() ssh strings, escaped double quotes (\") inside the remote command break cmd.exe quoting ('The system cannot find the path specified'); use single quotes doubled ('') only, or split into separate ssh calls.

cmrf7sf input-pair area vs noise (R5N-N): input-pair 1/f divided by the capacitive noise gain (Cc+Cfb+cgg)/Cc follows 1/sqrt(WL) within 0.6 %; the larger cgg (4.8 -> 7.5 pF on 50 pF Cc) raises every OTA1 term by the same factor, so N2 50/40 gave 2.99 uV instead of the naive 2.86 uV.

Noise cross-check (R5N-F): the noise summary txt's 'Total Input Referred Noise' equals the SKILL pointwise de-embedded value, and sqrt('Total Summarized Noise')/|H100| equals the app value (4 digits); re-integrating the 161-point noise CSV gives ~0.1 % lower.

Sticky analogLib parameters (R6C): an instance parameter NOT given to schCreateInst/acSetParam is filled with the value last used for that master in the Virtuoso session. Building two testbenches in one job gave the second bench's VSPS vsin sinephase=180 copied from the first bench's VSNS (both inputs in phase, vid = 0). Always set every parameter that differs between instances of the same master explicitly (e.g. sinephase 0), and diff the netlists of A/B benches.
r4Num() converts to float: use '%.0f' not '%d' for integer counts (a '%d' format error aborts the whole batch job after the simulation).
analogLib vcvs output clipping: CDF params maxm / minm (netlist max= / min=); egain is the gain.

Home quota on ieng6 is 5 GB and was down to ~16 MB after two 60 ms MOS-switch trans (21 MB psf each with save selected): delete this round's rebuildable tran psf dirs right after extracting the CSV; tar results into /tmp (not counted) before scp.
open_items: Axis labels on GUI family plots (hw1P1cFamily).
P2 AC setup inside an interactive ADE L run is untested (OCEAN check passed).
Consider making the repo private + deploy key, or keep it public and keep personal/PDK data out.
